hardJudge.note: 정답 C는 오콘쿼 주장의 두 요소(회의 이후 양자 협정으로 국경 확정 + 현지 지도자의 대응이 경계 위치에 영향)를 모두 직접 뒷받침한다. A는 회의 의제가 영토 분할이 아니었음을 시사해 부분적으로 그럴듯하고, D는 아프리카인 관련 내용이라 훑어 읽으면 끌릴 수 있으나 '영향'이 아닌 '배제'만 보여 준다. B는 회의 이전 구상이라 오히려 주장과 어긋난다. 두 단계 판단(주장 분해 + 선택지 대조)이 필요해 medium에 적합. 베를린 회의의 절차 규칙(통보·실효적 점유), 콩고·니제르강 자유항행 논의 등 역사적 배경 서술도 정확. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 정답 및 선택지 글자와 일치하며 모순 없음.

advisory.note: C는 '회의 이후 양자 협정'과 '현지 대응이 국경 형성' 두 요소를 모두 직접 뒷받침한다. A(의제가 영토 외 사안)와 D(아프리카인 관련)는 부분적으로 그럴듯한 오답이고, B도 말이 된다. 중간 난이도에 맞다. 오콘쿼는 가상 인물로 보인다.

problem.passage:
Historians have long debated what drove ordinary villagers in northern China to join the Boxer movement in 1899–1900. One traditional account emphasizes religious antagonism: the Boxers, it holds, were motivated chiefly by hostility toward Christian missionaries and converts. Historian Lin Wei offers an alternative view. She argues that economic disruption caused by foreign concessions, especially the railways and river shipping that put local cart drivers, boatmen, and porters out of work, was the primary factor that turned rural discontent into armed mobilization.

Which finding, if true, would most directly support Lin Wei's argument?
problem.stimulus: Historians have long debated what drove ordinary villagers in northern China to join the Boxer movement in 1899–1900. One traditional account emphasizes religious antagonism: the Boxers, it holds, were motivated chiefly by hostility toward Christian missionaries and converts. Historian Lin Wei offers an alternative view. She argues that economic disruption caused by foreign concessions, especially the railways and river shipping that put local cart drivers, boatmen, and porters out of work, was the primary factor that turned rural discontent into armed mobilization.
problem.question: Which finding, if true, would most directly support Lin Wei's argument?
options: Boxer recruitment was highest in counties where newly built foreign-run transport lines had replaced traditional hauling trades, even when those counties had few Christian converts.
Boxer recruitment was highest in counties with large Christian communities, regardless of whether foreign-run transport lines had been built there.
Boxer recruitment was highest in counties where foreign-run transport lines had been built, but only where missionaries had also founded churches in the same years.
Boxer recruitment was roughly equal in counties with and without foreign-run transport lines, though former boatmen often held leadership roles.
problem.explanation: 린 웨이는 운송업 일자리를 없앤 경제적 혼란이 동원의 주된 원인이었다고 주장한다. A는 운송 노선이 전통적 운반업을 대체한 지역에서 기독교인이 적어도 가담률이 높았다고 하므로, 종교적 요인과 분리된 경제적 요인을 보여 주장을 직접 뒷받침한다. B는 종교 중심의 전통적 설명을 지지한다. C는 운송 노선이 교회와 함께 있을 때만 효과가 있었다고 하므로 종교 요인과 구분되지 않아 경제 요인이 주된 원인임을 보여주지 못한다. D는 운송 노선 유무가 가담률에 차이를 만들지 않았다고 하므로 오히려 주장을 약화시키며, 지도자 역할은 대중 동원과 별개의 문제다.
problem.explanationEn: Lin Wei argues that economic disruption, meaning lost transport jobs, was the main reason people mobilized. Choice A ties high recruitment to places where traditional hauling trades were replaced, even when few Christians lived there. That separates the economic factor from the religious one, so A directly supports her claim. Choice B backs the traditional religious account instead. Choice C says transport lines mattered only where churches also appeared, so you can't tell the economic cause apart from the religious one. Choice D shows recruitment didn't change with transport lines, which actually weakens her claim, and who held leadership roles is a separate issue from how many people joined.

quality.seed: history and civics — The Boxer Rebellion of 1900 and Chinese resistance to foreign imperial concession spheres

hardJudge.note: 검산: 린 웨이 주장 = 운송업 실직이라는 경제적 혼란이 주된 동원 원인. A는 운송 노선이 전통 운반업을 대체한 지역에서 기독교인이 적어도 가담률이 높았다는 발견으로, 경제 요인을 종교 요인과 분리하여 직접 뒷받침함 → 정답 타당. B는 전통적 종교 설명 지지, C는 교회 동반 조건으로 요인 분리 불가(부분적 타당성), D는 운송 노선 효과 없음으로 약화하되 보트맨 지도부 언급으로 부분적 유인 보유. 두 오답(C, D)이 비교를 요하고 B도 말이 되므로 medium 적합. 린 웨이는 가상 역사가로 제시되며 의화단 운동의 배경(철도·기선으로 인한 운송업 실직)은 실제 사학계에서 논의되는 요인이므로 사실 오류 없음. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 선택지 글자 참조 일치, 결론 일치, 영어에 한글 없음. 형식 적정.

advisory.note: Lin Wei는 가상 인물로 보이며 의화단의 배경 설명은 무난하다. C와 D는 경제 요인의 근거를 일부 담고 있어 선택지끼리 비교해야 걸러진다. B는 반대 입장을 지지하는 그럴듯한 오답이다.

problem.passage:
In 1905, Japan defeated Russia in the Russo-Japanese War, becoming the first Asian nation in modern times to win a major war against a European power. Many Europeans at the time believed that their nations were naturally superior to others. Japan's victory ______ that belief: newspapers across Asia and Africa celebrated the result as proof that European power could be beaten.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.stimulus: In 1905, Japan defeated Russia in the Russo-Japanese War, becoming the first Asian nation in modern times to win a major war against a European power. Many Europeans at the time believed that their nations were naturally superior to others. Japan's victory ______ that belief: newspapers across Asia and Africa celebrated the result as proof that European power could be beaten.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
options: confirmed
undermined
ignored
inspired
problem.explanation: 콜론 뒤의 내용, 즉 유럽의 힘도 꺾일 수 있다는 증거라는 말은 일본의 승리가 유럽이 원래 우월하다는 믿음을 약화시켰음을 보여 준다. 그래서 '약화시키다'라는 뜻의 B가 정답이다. A는 믿음이 뒷받침되었다는 반대 의미가 된다. C는 승리가 그 믿음과 아무 관련이 없다는 뜻이 되어, 승리가 반증으로 받아들여졌다는 내용과 맞지 않는다. D는 승리가 그 믿음을 낳았다는 뜻이 되어 앞뒤 논리가 거꾸로 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The clue comes after the colon: people saw the victory as proof that European power could be beaten. That means the victory weakened the belief that Europeans were naturally superior, so B is correct. A would mean the victory supported that belief, which is the opposite. C would mean the victory had nothing to do with the belief, but the text says people took it as evidence against the belief. D would mean the victory created the belief, which reverses the logic.

quality.seed: history and civics — The Russo-Japanese War and first Asian military victory challenging European racial supremacy

hardJudge.note: 정답 B 검산: 콜론 뒤 '유럽의 힘도 꺾일 수 있다는 증거'가 유럽 우월 믿음을 약화시켰다는 뜻이므로 undermined가 유일하게 논리적. A(반대 의미), C(무관), D(믿음을 낳음)는 모두 오답이지만 각각 전형적 오개념으로 그럴듯함. 역사적 사실(1905년 러일전쟁 일본 승리, 아시아·아프리카 언론의 반응) 정확. 한국어·영어 해설 결론과 글자 참조 일치, 영어 자연스럽고 한글 없음. 단서가 콜론 뒤에 직접 제시되고 추론 한 단계, 어휘 평이 → easy 적합. 형식(선택지 4개, 질문문 표준) 문제 없음.

advisory.note: 콜론 뒤 단서가 직접적이고 한 단계 추론으로 풀린다. confirmed는 반대 의미의 전형적 오답이다. 다만 ignored와 inspired는 다소 쉽게 배제된다.

problem.passage:
In 1908, a group of reform-minded officers known as the Young Turks forced Sultan Abdulhamid II to bring back the Ottoman constitution, which he had suspended thirty years earlier. The reformers hoped that an elected parliament would give the empire's many peoples a shared voice in government and keep the state from breaking apart. Their hopes were soon tested, however: within a few years, the empire had lost territory in North Africa and the Balkans, showing that the new constitution could not ______ the empire's decline.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.stimulus: In 1908, a group of reform-minded officers known as the Young Turks forced Sultan Abdulhamid II to bring back the Ottoman constitution, which he had suspended thirty years earlier. The reformers hoped that an elected parliament would give the empire's many peoples a shared voice in government and keep the state from breaking apart. Their hopes were soon tested, however: within a few years, the empire had lost territory in North Africa and the Balkans, showing that the new constitution could not ______ the empire's decline.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
options: accelerate
celebrate
halt
explain
problem.explanation: 지문은 개혁가들이 헌법으로 제국의 분열을 막으려 했지만 곧 영토를 잃었다고 말하므로, 빈칸에는 헌법이 쇠퇴를 '멈추지' 못했다는 뜻이 들어가야 한다. 따라서 C가 정답이다. A는 '가속하다'로, 헌법이 쇠퇴를 가속하지 못했다는 말은 개혁가의 목표와 반대이다. B는 '기념하다'로, 쇠퇴를 기념한다는 것은 문맥과 맞지 않는다. D는 '설명하다'로, 지문의 초점은 쇠퇴를 이해하는 것이 아니라 막는 것이다.
problem.explanationEn: The text says the reformers hoped the constitution would keep the empire from breaking apart, but the empire soon lost territory anyway. So the blank needs a word meaning "stop": the constitution could not stop the decline. That makes C correct. A means "speed up," which is the opposite of what the reformers wanted, so saying it failed to do that doesn't make sense. B means "honor," which doesn't fit talk of losing land. D means "account for," but the passage is about preventing the decline, not understanding it.

quality.seed: history and civics — The Young Turk Revolution and Ottoman constitutional reforms attempting to prevent empire collapse

hardJudge.note: 지문 단서("keep the state from breaking apart" vs. "lost territory")가 명시적이고 'halt'가 유일하게 논리적으로 맞음. 역사적 사실(1876 헌법, 1878 정지, 1908 복원, 1911-13 북아프리카·발칸 상실) 정확. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 C를 일관되게 뒷받침하며 오답 설명도 타당. 오답은 반대어(accelerate), 문맥 무관(celebrate), 그럴듯한 연어(explain)로 구성되어 easy 난이도에 적합.

advisory.note: 역사 사실 정확(1878 정지, 1908 복원, 리비아·발칸 상실). 단서 'keep the state from breaking apart'가 직접적이며 halt가 유일한 정답. B는 다소 약한 오답이나 허용 범위.

problem.passage:
Historians have long debated whether the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, signed in March 1918, actually helped Germany's war effort. By ending fighting on the Eastern Front, the treaty let German commanders move troops west for the spring offensives that spring. Some scholars argue that the treaty therefore gave Germany a decisive advantage in manpower. Historian Lena Marwitz looked at this claim through German railway transfer records. __She found that about half a million soldiers moved from east to west between November 1917 and March 1918, but that roughly one million stayed behind to occupy Ukraine and the Baltic territories the treaty had handed to German control.__ Marwitz concludes that Brest-Litovsk did strengthen Germany's western armies, but much less than the territorial terms might suggest, because the same treaty that freed troops also tied many of them down.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
problem.stimulus: Historians have long debated whether the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, signed in March 1918, actually helped Germany's war effort. By ending fighting on the Eastern Front, the treaty let German commanders move troops west for the spring offensives that spring. Some scholars argue that the treaty therefore gave Germany a decisive advantage in manpower. Historian Lena Marwitz looked at this claim through German railway transfer records. __She found that about half a million soldiers moved from east to west between November 1917 and March 1918, but that roughly one million stayed behind to occupy Ukraine and the Baltic territories the treaty had handed to German control.__ Marwitz concludes that Brest-Litovsk did strengthen Germany's western armies, but much less than the territorial terms might suggest, because the same treaty that freed troops also tied many of them down.
problem.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It presents evidence suggesting that the treaty gave Germany the decisive manpower advantage some scholars attribute to it.
It presents evidence that the treaty moved soldiers westward, while leaving open whether the transfers affected German strength at all.
It presents evidence that the large western offensives were what led Germany to seek the treaty and occupy eastern territories.
It presents evidence that the treaty added to Germany's western forces, though only to a limited degree, supporting a qualified version of a claim.
problem.explanation:
정답 D: 밑줄 문장은 약 50만 명이 서부로 이동했지만(강화), 약 100만 명이 점령 때문에 동부에 남았다(제한)는 두 내용을 함께 제시한다. 그래서 '강화했지만 생각보다 훨씬 적게'라는 마르비츠의 제한된 결론과 범위가 정확히 맞는다.
A(과장): 근거는 오히려 '결정적 우위'라는 주장을 약화시킨다. 지문이 지지하는 것보다 넓은 결론이다.
B(부분 반영): 병력 이동 부분만 보고, 잔류 병력이 효과를 제한했다는 점과 실제로 서부 병력이 늘었다는 결론을 빠뜨렸다.
C(인과 역전): 지문에서는 조약이 병력 이동과 공세를 가능하게 했다. 공세 때문에 조약을 맺은 것이 아니다.
problem.explanationEn:
D is correct. The underlined sentence gives two facts together. About half a million soldiers moved west, which made the western armies stronger. But about a million stayed in the east to occupy the territories the treaty gave Germany, which limited that gain. This fits Marwitz's limited conclusion exactly: the treaty strengthened the west, "but much less" than expected.
A overstates the evidence. The figures actually weaken the claim that Germany gained a "decisive" manpower advantage.
B uses only part of the evidence. It ignores the troops left behind, and it leaves out the conclusion the text actually draws: that German strength did increase.
C reverses cause and effect. In the text, the treaty freed troops for the offensives. The offensives did not cause Germany to seek the treaty.

hardJudge.note: 밑줄 문장은 '50만 이동(강화) + 100만 잔류(제한)'의 이중 구조로, 학자들의 주장→마르비츠의 검증→제한된 결론이라는 논리 사슬 속에서 '제한적 지지' 역할을 한다. D가 근거 범위와 결론 범위를 정확히 일치시키며, A(과장), B(부분 반영·효과 불확실로 축소), C(인과 역전)가 각각 레시피의 오답 유형에 대응한다. 가상의 역사학자(Lena Marwitz)와 수치는 창작으로 보이며 역사적 틀(1918년 3월 조약, 서부 이동, 우크라이나·발트 점령)은 사실과 부합한다. 사소한 문체 문제: "for the spring offensives that spring" 중복 표현이 있으나 판정에 영향 없음.

advisory.note: 정답 D가 맞습니다. 밑줄 문장은 서부로 이동한 50만 명과 동부에 남은 100만 명을 함께 제시해, 강화는 했지만 제한적이었다는 결론을 뒷받침합니다. A는 과장, B는 부분 반영, C는 인과 역전 오답으로 체크리스트 항목에 정확히 대응합니다. 사소한 문장 결함이 두 가지 있습니다. 첫째, 'for the spring offensives that spring'은 spring이 중복됩니다. 둘째, 병력 이동 기간(1917년 11월~1918년 3월)이 대부분 조약 서명(1918년 3월) 이전이라 '조약이 병력을 풀어 주었다'는 서술과 시점이 어긋나 보입니다(실제로는 1917년 12월 휴전이 있었음). 다만 두 가지 모두 정답 판정에는 영향이 없습니다.

problem.passage:
When a small group of Irish nationalists seized buildings in Dublin during Easter week of 1916, most Dubliners regarded the rebellion as a reckless failure: it was crushed within six days, and some residents jeered at captured rebels as they were marched through the streets. __Over the following weeks, however, British authorities court-martialed and executed fifteen of the rising's leaders, often after secret proceedings that newspapers described in grim detail.__ Public sympathy shifted sharply toward the executed men, and in the 1918 general election the separatist party Sinn Féin, which had played little role in the rising itself, won a large majority of Ireland's seats. Historians therefore argue that the rising's influence on the push for Irish independence came less from the rebellion than from the response it provoked.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
problem.stimulus: When a small group of Irish nationalists seized buildings in Dublin during Easter week of 1916, most Dubliners regarded the rebellion as a reckless failure: it was crushed within six days, and some residents jeered at captured rebels as they were marched through the streets. __Over the following weeks, however, British authorities court-martialed and executed fifteen of the rising's leaders, often after secret proceedings that newspapers described in grim detail.__ Public sympathy shifted sharply toward the executed men, and in the 1918 general election the separatist party Sinn Féin, which had played little role in the rising itself, won a large majority of Ireland's seats. Historians therefore argue that the rising's influence on the push for Irish independence came less from the rebellion than from the response it provoked.
problem.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It introduces the development that connects the rising's initial unpopularity to the later change in public opinion, which in turn supports the historians' claim about where the rising's influence came from.
It explains why the rising was crushed so quickly, which accounts for the scorn that Dubliners initially showed the rebels.
It presents the electoral success of Sinn Féin as evidence that the executions directly benefited the party that organized the rising.
It states the main argument of the text, which the account of the 1918 election then illustrates with a specific example.
problem.explanation: 정답 A: 밑줄 문장(처형)은 '반란이 처음엔 비웃음을 샀다'와 '여론이 바뀌어 1918년 선거에서 승리했다'를 이어 주는 연결 고리이다. 이 연결이 다시 '영향력은 반란 자체보다 그에 대한 대응에서 나왔다'는 결론을 뒷받침한다. 즉 두 단계를 거치는 역할이다. B: 앞 문장과만 연결한 한 단계짜리 해석이다. 처형은 진압이 끝난 뒤의 일이라 진압이 빨랐던 이유를 설명하지 않는다. C: 다음 문장(선거)의 역할과 헷갈린 것이다. 게다가 지문에 따르면 Sinn Féin은 봉기에서 한 역할이 거의 없었으므로 '봉기를 조직한 정당'이라는 설명도 틀렸다. D: 지문 전체의 목적과 이 문장 하나의 기능을 뒤바꾼 것이다. 핵심 주장은 마지막 문장에 나오고, 밑줄 문장은 그 주장을 받쳐 주는 사건일 뿐이다.
problem.explanationEn:
Choice A is correct. The underlined sentence describes the executions, and they're the link between two things: the rising's early unpopularity (people jeered at the rebels) and the later shift in public sympathy that led to Sinn Féin's 1918 victory. That chain then supports the final claim that the rising mattered mainly because of the response it provoked. To see this role, you have to connect two steps.

Choice B only looks one step back. The executions happened after the rising had already been crushed, so they can't explain why it was crushed so quickly.

Choice C mixes up the underlined sentence with the next sentence, which is the one about the election. It also contradicts the text: Sinn Féin "played little role in the rising itself," so it didn't organize it.

Choice D confuses the text's overall purpose with the job of this one sentence. The main argument comes in the last sentence. The underlined sentence gives an event that supports that argument.

hardJudge.note: 지문은 '초기 비웃음 → 처형 → 여론 전환 → 1918 선거 → 역사가 결론'의 명확한 다단계 논리 사슬을 갖추고 있으며, 밑줄 문장은 앞뒤 단계를 잇는 전환점이다. A는 앞 단계(초기 불인기)와 뒤 단계(여론 변화)를 연결하고 이것이 다시 결론을 뒷받침한다는 점을 정확히 서술하여 유일하게 성립한다. B는 밑줄 문장을 앞 문장(진압)과만 연결하되 시간 순서상 불가능한 인과(처형이 신속한 진압의 원인)를 제시해 인접 단계 혼동형 오답으로 기능하고, C는 다음 문장(선거)의 역할을 가져오면서 'Sinn Féin이 봉기를 조직했다'는 지문과 모순되는 내용을 포함하며, D는 지문 전체 주장(마지막 문장)과 밑줄 문장의 개별 기능을 뒤바꾼 형태다. 사실 관계(6일 내 진압, 15명 처형, 비공개 군법회의, Sinn Féin의 미미한 역할과 1918년 압승, '대응이 더 큰 영향'이라는 역사가들의 통설)도 정확하다. 문장 길이는 적정하며 난이도는 단계 연결에서 비롯된다. hard 적합.

advisory.note: 사실관계(처형 15명, 1918년 Sinn Féin 압승, 봉기에서 Sinn Féin의 역할이 작았던 점)가 정확하다. A는 밑줄 문장이 초기 반응과 여론 변화를 잇고 마지막 결론으로 이어지는 두 단계 역할을 정확히 짚었다. B는 앞 단계와, C는 다음 단계와 혼동하도록 만든 오답이고, D는 지문 전체 목적과 개별 문장의 기능을 뒤바꾼 오답이다. 다만 C는 사실 오류가 있어 쉽게 걸러질 수 있다.

problem.passage:
Historians have long debated how heavily the reparations imposed by the 1919 Treaty of Versailles actually weighed on Germany's economy. Some scholars note that Germany paid only a fraction of the sum on paper, often with borrowed foreign money. Yet even these scholars concede that the reparations' political effect was hard to overstate: many Germans saw the payments as a lasting humiliation, and nationalist politicians repeatedly ______ that resentment, blaming the Weimar Republic's leaders for accepting the treaty and turning public anger into support for their own movements.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.stimulus: Historians have long debated how heavily the reparations imposed by the 1919 Treaty of Versailles actually weighed on Germany's economy. Some scholars note that Germany paid only a fraction of the sum on paper, often with borrowed foreign money. Yet even these scholars concede that the reparations' political effect was hard to overstate: many Germans saw the payments as a lasting humiliation, and nationalist politicians repeatedly ______ that resentment, blaming the Weimar Republic's leaders for accepting the treaty and turning public anger into support for their own movements.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
options: alleviated
exploited
documented
underestimated
problem.explanation: 지문은 민족주의 정치인들이 바이마르 지도자들을 비난하며 대중의 분노를 자신들의 지지로 '바꿨다'고 말하므로, 그 분노를 정치적으로 이용했다는 B가 정답이다. A는 분노를 '완화했다'는 뜻으로, 분노를 지지로 전환했다는 내용과 반대이다. C는 정치인들이 분노를 다뤘다는 점에서 일부 맞아 보이지만, 단순히 '기록했다'는 의미로는 분노를 지지로 바꾼 적극적 행위를 담아내지 못한다. D는 앞 문장의 '과소평가'를 둘러싼 학자 논쟁과 연결돼 보이지만, 분노를 적극 활용했다는 문맥과 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The text says nationalist politicians blamed Weimar leaders and turned public anger into support for their own movements, so they used that resentment for political gain. That makes B the right answer. A means "eased," which is the opposite of stirring up anger and turning it into support. C might look right because the politicians did engage with the resentment, but simply "recording" it doesn't capture how they actively converted it into support. D seems to echo the scholarly debate about how heavy the reparations were, but it doesn't fit politicians who were actively using the anger.

quality.seed: history and civics — The Treaty of Versailles and punitive German reparations fueling Weimar Republic economic resentment

hardJudge.note: 정답 검산: "blaming the Weimar Republic's leaders ... turning public anger into support for their own movements"는 분노를 정치적으로 이용했다는 뜻이므로 B exploited가 유일하게 논리적·정확함. A는 반대 의미, C는 '기록'으로 적극적 전환 행위를 담지 못함, D는 첫 문장의 학자 논쟁('how heavily ... weighed')에서 파생된 그럴듯한 미끼. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 B를 지지하고 글자 참조 일치, 영어 자연스럽고 한글 없음. 사실 관계(배상금 일부만 지불, 외국 차입금 활용—도스 플랜 등)도 역사적 통설과 부합. 난이도는 'exploited resentment'가 흔한 연어라 다소 쉬운 편이지만, 긴 분사구에서 근거를 연결해야 하고 D가 훑어 읽기 시 함정으로 작동하므로 medium 범위로 판단.

advisory.note: 빈칸 바로 뒤의 'blaming... turning public anger into support'가 '이용하다'라는 뜻을 거의 직접 알려 준다. 그래서 두 단계 추론이 필요하지 않다. 오답 A는 반대 뜻이라 바로 걸러진다. C와 D도 부분적인 근거가 약해 비교하지 않아도 배제된다. medium 기준인 '오답 중 최소 2개가 그럴듯해야 함'을 충족하지 못한다.

problem.passage:
Signed in 1925, the Locarno Treaties committed Germany, France, and Belgium to respect their shared borders, with Britain and Italy pledging to aid any victim of aggression. Contemporaries hailed the agreements as the dawn of a new era, and the foreign ministers of Germany and France even shared the Nobel Peace Prize. Yet historian Patrick Cohrs and others note that the "spirit of Locarno" proved ______: within a decade, the economic shock of the Depression and the rise of the Nazi regime had undone the trust the treaties fostered, and in 1936 German troops reoccupied the Rhineland in open defiance of the settlement.

Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
problem.stimulus: Signed in 1925, the Locarno Treaties committed Germany, France, and Belgium to respect their shared borders, with Britain and Italy pledging to aid any victim of aggression. Contemporaries hailed the agreements as the dawn of a new era, and the foreign ministers of Germany and France even shared the Nobel Peace Prize. Yet historian Patrick Cohrs and others note that the "spirit of Locarno" proved ______: within a decade, the economic shock of the Depression and the rise of the Nazi regime had undone the trust the treaties fostered, and in 1936 German troops reoccupied the Rhineland in open defiance of the settlement.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
options: contentious
symbolic
fleeting
ambiguous
problem.explanation: 빈칸 뒤에서 조약이 만든 신뢰가 10년 안에 무너졌고 1936년 라인란트 재점령으로 깨졌다고 설명하므로, 그 '정신'이 오래가지 못했다는 뜻의 C(fleeting)가 정답이다. A(contentious)는 논쟁적이었다는 뜻이지만, 지문은 당시 사람들이 조약을 환영했다고 하므로 맞지 않는다. B(symbolic)는 노벨상 같은 상징적 요소와 연결돼 그럴듯해 보이지만, 빈칸 뒤 근거는 실질이 없었다는 점이 아니라 시간이 지나며 무너졌다는 점이다. D(ambiguous)는 조약 조건이 불분명했다는 뜻인데, 지문은 국경 존중이라는 명확한 약속을 서술하고 있다.
problem.explanationEn: The text after the blank says that the trust built by the treaties was undone within a decade and that the settlement was openly defied in 1936. That shows the spirit didn't last, so C ("fleeting") is the answer. A ("contentious") means disputed, but the text says people at the time welcomed the agreements. B ("symbolic") seems plausible because of the Nobel Prize, but the evidence after the blank is about the spirit collapsing over time, not about it lacking real substance. D ("ambiguous") means unclear, but the text describes clear commitments to respect borders.

quality.seed: history and civics — The Locarno Treaties and German-French reconciliation stabilizing Western European security briefly

hardJudge.note: "Yet ... proved ______: within a decade ... undone" clearly signals short-lived → C(fleeting). Historical facts (1925 Locarno, Stresemann/Briand Nobel 1926, 1936 Rhineland, Cohrs as Locarno historian) check out. B(symbolic) is a strong partial-fit distractor, D(ambiguous) plausible on a skim, A(contentious) contradicted by contemporaries' acclaim—meets medium design. Korean and English explanations match each other and the lettering; English is natural with no Hangul.

advisory.note: 사실관계 확인: 1925년 로카르노 조약, 1925년 체임벌린과 도스, 1926년 브리앙과 슈트레제만의 노벨평화상 수상, 1936년 라인란트 재점령 모두 정확하다. 정답 C는 'Yet'으로 시작하는 대조와 'within a decade'라는 시간 단서를 연결해야 확정되므로 medium 난이도에 맞다. 오답 B는 노벨상 언급 때문에 그럴듯하게 보이고, 오답 D와 A도 그럴듯하다.

problem.passage:
In October 1934, roughly 86,000 soldiers of the Chinese Communist Party's Red Army broke out of their encircled base in Jiangxi Province and began a retreat that would cover thousands of miles over the following year. Party histories later celebrated this Long March as a triumphant act of endurance. __Yet only a small fraction of those who set out reached northern Shaanxi in late 1935, and many historians describe the march as a desperate flight rather than a planned campaign.__ What makes the episode historically significant, these scholars argue, is less the journey itself than what followed: from their new base at Yan'an, the surviving leaders rebuilt the party, trained cadres, and developed the political strategies that would later carry them to power.

Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
problem.stimulus: In October 1934, roughly 86,000 soldiers of the Chinese Communist Party's Red Army broke out of their encircled base in Jiangxi Province and began a retreat that would cover thousands of miles over the following year. Party histories later celebrated this Long March as a triumphant act of endurance. __Yet only a small fraction of those who set out reached northern Shaanxi in late 1935, and many historians describe the march as a desperate flight rather than a planned campaign.__ What makes the episode historically significant, these scholars argue, is less the journey itself than what followed: from their new base at Yan'an, the surviving leaders rebuilt the party, trained cadres, and developed the political strategies that would later carry them to power.
problem.question: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?
options: It gives statistical evidence that the Red Army's losses during the march were greater than party histories have acknowledged.
It explains why the Communist leaders chose northern Shaanxi rather than another region as the site of their new base.
It presents the main claim of the text, which the final sentence then supports with examples of the march's achievements.
It complicates a celebratory account of the march, setting up the text's claim about where the episode's real importance lies.
problem.explanation: 밑줄 문장은 'Yet'으로 앞 문장의 승리 서사에 의문을 제기하고, 이어지는 마지막 문장이 이 사건의 진짜 의의는 행군 자체보다 옌안에서의 재건에 있다고 주장하도록 길을 열어 주므로 D가 정답이다. A는 손실이 '작은 일부만 도착'했다는 점을 맞게 짚지만, 공식 역사가 손실을 축소했다는 주장은 지문에 없고 수치도 제시되지 않는다. B는 샨시라는 지명을 활용했지만 그 지역을 고른 이유는 설명되지 않는다. C는 이 문장을 중심 주장으로 보지만, 마지막 문장은 행군의 성과가 아니라 그 이후의 일을 강조하므로 이 문장을 뒷받침하지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The underlined sentence starts with "Yet" and pushes back on the triumphant version of the story told by party histories. That pushback prepares the reader for the final sentence, which argues that the episode really matters because of what happened afterward at Yan'an, so D is correct. A picks up on the heavy losses, but the text never claims that party histories hid them, and it gives no actual figures. B uses the place name Shaanxi, but the text never says why that region was chosen. C calls this sentence the main claim, but the final sentence does not back it up with the march's achievements. Instead, it moves the focus to events after the march.

quality.seed: history and civics — The Long March of 1934 and Chinese Communist Party survival establishing Yan'an base

hardJudge.note: 밑줄 문장은 'Yet'으로 앞 문장의 승리 서사를 반박하고, 마지막 문장의 '진짜 의의는 이후 옌안에서의 재건'이라는 주장으로 이어지는 전환 역할을 하므로 D가 정답임을 직접 확인함. A는 '소수만 도착'이라는 손실 언급을 부분적으로 반영하나 '공식 역사가 축소했다'는 주장과 통계 수치가 지문에 없고, B는 지명만 차용, C는 마지막 문장이 행군의 성과가 아닌 이후 사건을 다루므로 배제됨. 역사적 사실(1934년 10월 장시 출발, 약 86,000명, 1935년 말 산시 북부 도착, 극소수 생존)은 통설과 일치하며 옌안 기지 표현은 통상적 단순화 수준. 한·영 해설 결론 및 선택지 참조 일치, 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 두 문장 간 연결(반박+설정)을 요구하는 구조로 medium에 적합.

advisory.note: 사실관계(1934년 10월 약 8만 6천 명 출발, 1935년 말 산시 북부 도착, 옌안 근거지)가 정확하다. A는 큰 손실이라는 점은 맞게 짚지만 '통계 근거'와 '공식 역사가 손실을 인정하지 않았다'는 대목이 지문에 없다. C는 밑줄 문장의 대조 기능은 맞게 보지만 마지막 문장의 역할을 잘못 해석했다. 따라서 두 오답 모두 비교해야 배제되는 매력적 오답으로, medium 난이도에 맞다.

problem.passage:
In late November 1939, Soviet forces invaded Finland, expecting to defeat a country whose army was a fraction of the size of their own. The campaign did not go as planned. Gliding silently on skis through the frozen forests north of Lake Ladoga, ______ Although Finland eventually gave up territory in the March 1940 peace settlement, its resistance kept the nation independent.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In late November 1939, Soviet forces invaded Finland, expecting to defeat a country whose army was a fraction of the size of their own. The campaign did not go as planned. Gliding silently on skis through the frozen forests north of Lake Ladoga, ______ Although Finland eventually gave up territory in the March 1940 peace settlement, its resistance kept the nation independent.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: the dense, snow-covered terrain hid small Finnish units as they surrounded and broke apart long Soviet columns stuck on the region's few narrow roads.
small Finnish units surrounded and broke apart long Soviet columns stuck on the region's few narrow roads.
the Soviet forces saw their long columns, stuck on the region's few narrow roads, surrounded and broken apart by small Finnish units.
Finland's commander, Marshal Carl Gustaf Mannerheim, had small units surround and break apart long Soviet columns stuck on the region's few narrow roads.
problem.explanation:
분사구 'Gliding silently on skis through the frozen forests'가 수식하는 대상은 실제로 스키를 타고 숲을 지나간 행위자여야 하며, 그 행위자는 핀란드 소부대이다. 따라서 'small Finnish units'를 주어로 둔 B가 정답이다.
A: 분사구에 나온 'forests'와 가장 가까운 무생물 명사인 지형(terrain)을 주어로 삼았다. 이렇게 되면 지형이 스키를 탄 셈이 된다.
C: 앞 문장의 배경 명사인 'Soviet forces'를 주어로 삼았다. 이렇게 되면 침공군이 스키로 숲을 지나간 것처럼 읽히는데, 소련군은 오히려 도로에 묶여 있었다.
D: 핀란드 쪽 인물이라는 점에서 그럴듯해 보이지만, 지휘관 만네르헤임은 직접 스키를 타고 숲을 지나간 행위자가 아니다. 명령을 내린 사람일 뿐이므로 수식 관계가 어긋난다.
problem.explanationEn:
The opening phrase "Gliding silently on skis through the frozen forests" has to describe whoever actually did the gliding. That's the small Finnish units, so B is correct because it puts them in the subject position.
A is wrong because it makes "terrain" the subject. That's the nonhuman noun closest in meaning to "forests," and the sentence ends up saying the terrain was skiing.
C is wrong because it uses the background noun "the Soviet forces" as the subject. That says the invaders were skiing through the forest, but they were actually stuck on the roads.
D is wrong because it makes Mannerheim the subject. He's on the Finnish side, but he gave the orders and wasn't the one gliding on skis through the forest, so the modifier still doesn't match.

hardJudge.note: B가 유일하게 분사구의 행위자(스키로 숲을 통과한 주체)와 주절 주어가 일치하므로 정답 타당. A(지형)·C(소련군)는 명백한 현수수식어 오류. 다만 D는 구조적으로는 사람(만네르헤임)이 주어이므로 순수 문법 관점에서 Standard English 위반이라 단정하기 어렵고, 오답 판정이 '지휘관은 직접 스키를 타지 않았다'는 지문 외적·역사적 추론에 의존한다는 점이 약점임(지문 내에 이를 배제하는 단서 없음). 정답 자체는 가장 적절하나 D의 방어 가능성이 다소 낮음을 유의. 겨울전쟁 연대·평화조약 시기·모티 전술 등 사실관계는 정확.

advisory.note: 문두 분사구문의 의미상 행위자를 가려내는 문항이다. 오답 D(만네르헤임)는 핀란드 측 인물이라 그럴듯하지만, 명령한 사람과 실제로 스키를 탄 행위자를 구분해야 하므로 medium보다 한 단계 더 생각해야 한다. 역사적 사실(1939년 11월 침공, 1940년 3월 강화, 라도가 호 북쪽 스키 부대의 포위 전술)에도 오류가 없다.

problem.passage:
When British and Indian leaders agreed in 1947 to divide British India and create Pakistan as a separate Muslim nation-state, the boundary commission led by Cyril Radcliffe was expected to draw lines that would sort Punjab and Bengal into two coherent, religiously defined territories______ Muslims, Hindus, and Sikhs had lived side by side in those provinces for generations, so the new borders left millions of people on the "wrong" side, and the mass migrations that followed were marked by communal violence that killed hundreds of thousands.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: When British and Indian leaders agreed in 1947 to divide British India and create Pakistan as a separate Muslim nation-state, the boundary commission led by Cyril Radcliffe was expected to draw lines that would sort Punjab and Bengal into two coherent, religiously defined territories______ Muslims, Hindus, and Sikhs had lived side by side in those provinces for generations, so the new borders left millions of people on the "wrong" side, and the mass migrations that followed were marked by communal violence that killed hundreds of thousands.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: , in practice,
; therefore,
; in practice,
, but, however,
problem.explanation: 앞 절은 국경이 인구를 깔끔하게 나눌 것이라는 '기대'이고, 뒤 절은 여러 공동체가 섞여 살아 그 기대가 깨졌다는 '현실'이므로 두 절은 대조 관계이다. 두 독립절은 세미콜론으로 잇고, 대조를 나타내는 접속부사 'in practice' 뒤에 콤마를 찍는 C가 정답이다. A: 콤마만으로 두 독립절을 이어 콤마 스플라이스가 된다. B: 구두점 형식은 맞지만 'therefore'는 인과를 나타내므로, 공존 사실이 기대에서 나온 결과처럼 읽혀 논리가 틀린다. D: 대조 접속사 'but'과 접속부사 'however'를 함께 써서 같은 대조 표시가 중복된다.
problem.explanationEn: The first clause gives an expectation: the borders would sort the provinces into coherent territories. The second clause gives the reality that undercut it: the communities were intermixed. So the two clauses contrast. Both are independent clauses, so they need a semicolon, and a contrast adverb like "in practice" followed by a comma fits. That makes C correct. A joins two independent clauses with only commas, which is a comma splice. B has correct punctuation, but "therefore" signals cause and effect, as if the intermixed population resulted from the expectation, and that logic is wrong. D stacks "but" and "however," two words that both signal contrast, so the contrast is marked twice.

hardJudge.note: 앞 절(기대)·뒤 절(현실: 혼거 → 국경이 인구를 가르지 못함 → 대규모 이주·폭력)의 대조 관계가 접속어 없이도 'so the new borders left millions on the wrong side'로 파악 가능. C는 세미콜론+접속부사+콤마로 형식·논리 모두 충족. A 콤마 스플라이스, B 형식은 맞으나 인과(therefore)로 논리 오류, D 'but, however' 대조 표지 중복. B가 형식상 정답과 동일하므로 의미 판단이 선행되어야 하는 점에서 medium 이상. 역사 사실(1947 분할, Radcliffe 위원회, Punjab·Bengal, 수십만 사망)도 통설과 일치.

advisory.note: B와 C는 구두점이 같아서, 기대와 현실이 대조된다는 의미 판단을 해야만 둘을 구분할 수 있다. A(콤마 스플라이스)와 D(접속어 중복)는 형식만 봐도 쉽게 탈락하는 오답이라 난이도 상승 폭은 크지 않다.

problem.passage:
By the fourteenth century, merchants of the Hanseatic League had developed a remarkably consistent method for evaluating wool shipped through their trading posts. The grading system used by Hanseatic agents in Bruges, which sorted bales of English and Flemish wool into ranked classes according to fiber length, cleanliness, and color, ______ buyers in distant ports such as Novgorod and Riga to purchase shipments without inspecting them in person.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: By the fourteenth century, merchants of the Hanseatic League had developed a remarkably consistent method for evaluating wool shipped through their trading posts. The grading system used by Hanseatic agents in Bruges, which sorted bales of English and Flemish wool into ranked classes according to fiber length, cleanliness, and color, ______ buyers in distant ports such as Novgorod and Riga to purchase shipments without inspecting them in person.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: allowing
were allowing
have allowed
allowed
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 단수 명사 'The grading system'이고, 'used by ... Bruges'와 'which ... color' 수식어구 뒤에 이 주어의 정동사가 와야 한다. 그리고 지문 전체가 14세기 과거 상황을 서술하므로 단수 주어와 맞는 과거형 정동사 D 'allowed'가 정답이다. A 'allowing'은 분사라서 정동사가 아니므로 문장이 완성되지 않는다. B 'were allowing'은 과거 시제는 맞지만 가까이 있는 복수 명사(bales, classes)에 끌린 복수형이라 단수 주어와 일치하지 않는다. C 'have allowed'는 복수형이고 현재완료라서 수 일치와 시제가 모두 틀렸다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is the singular noun "The grading system." It is followed by two long modifiers ("used by ... Bruges" and "which ... color"), and only after them does the main verb appear. The passage describes the fourteenth century, so the blank needs a singular, past-tense main verb, and that is D, "allowed." A, "allowing," is a participle, not a main verb, so the sentence would be incomplete. B, "were allowing," is in the past tense, but it is plural, probably pulled toward nearby plural nouns like "bales" and "classes," so it doesn't agree with the singular subject. C, "have allowed," is wrong twice: it is plural and in the present perfect, so neither its number nor its tense fits.

quality.seed: economics and business — Hanseatic League standardized wool grading systems enabling quality assurance in Northern European trade networks

hardJudge.note: 주어 'The grading system'(단수) 뒤에 'used by ... Bruges'와 'which ... color' 두 수식어가 이어지고 빈칸이 유일한 정동사 자리임을 직접 확인. A는 분사라 문장 단편, B는 복수형(가까운 bales/classes에 끌림), C는 복수형+현재완료로 수·시제 모두 부적합. D 'allowed'가 단수 주어·과거 시제에 맞아 정답 타당. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 같은 글자 참조와 결론으로 일관되며 영어 해설 자연스럽고 한글 없음. 한자동맹·브뤼헤 상관·노브고로드·리가 등 역사적 배경도 무리 없음. 긴 수식어 넘어 주어 찾기 + 시제 판단의 두 단계가 필요하고 B·C가 부분적으로 맞는 근거를 가져 medium에 적합.

advisory.note: 긴 수식어구를 지나 단수 주어와 정동사의 수를 맞추고 과거 시제까지 확인해야 하므로 판단이 두 단계다. 함정으로는 가까운 복수 명사에 이끌린 B와 분사 A가 있다. Bruges 상관과 노브고로드 교역은 사실관계상 그럴듯하다.

problem.passage:
By the 1890s, American hosiery mills demanded raw silk that would not snap on high-speed power looms, and Japanese exporters responded by standardizing cocoon breeds and grading thread before sale. The cooperative marketing associations formed in Nagano Prefecture, each of which pooled cocoons from hundreds of small family farms and sorted them by filament thickness, ______ buyers with silk of consistent grade, an advantage that Italian reelers, who still sold mostly through individual merchants, struggled to match.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: By the 1890s, American hosiery mills demanded raw silk that would not snap on high-speed power looms, and Japanese exporters responded by standardizing cocoon breeds and grading thread before sale. The cooperative marketing associations formed in Nagano Prefecture, each of which pooled cocoons from hundreds of small family farms and sorted them by filament thickness, ______ buyers with silk of consistent grade, an advantage that Italian reelers, who still sold mostly through individual merchants, struggled to match.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: was supplying
supplying
supplied
having supplied
problem.explanation: 문장의 주어는 복수 명사 "associations"이며, "each of which..." 관계절은 삽입된 수식어일 뿐이므로 빈칸에는 복수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하다. C의 "supplied"는 과거 시제 정동사로 수 일치와 문장 완결을 모두 만족한다. A는 정동사이지만 가까운 "each"나 "thickness"에 끌린 단수형이라 복수 주어와 맞지 않는다. B와 D는 분사 형태여서 주어에 대응하는 정동사가 없는 불완전한 문장을 만든다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of the sentence is the plural noun "associations"; the clause "each of which... thickness" is just an interrupting modifier, so the blank needs a finite verb that agrees with a plural subject. C, "supplied," is a past-tense finite verb that works with a plural subject and completes the sentence. A is a finite verb, but it is singular, likely attracted by the nearby "each" or "thickness," so it doesn't agree with "associations." B and D are participle forms, which leave the subject without a main verb and create a sentence fragment.

quality.seed: economics and business — Japanese silk industry cocoon standardization and cooperative marketing defeating Italian competition

hardJudge.note: 주어 "associations"(복수) 뒤에 "formed in Nagano Prefecture"와 "each of which ... thickness"라는 두 겹의 수식어가 삽입되어 있어 주어 식별 후 정동사·수 일치를 판단해야 하는 2단계 문항. C "supplied"만 복수 주어에 맞는 정동사로 문장을 완결함. A는 정동사이나 단수형("each"/"thickness"에 끌린 오답), B·D는 분사형이라 정동사 부재로 단편문이 됨. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 동일 결론과 글자 참조를 가지며 정확함. 역사적 배경(1890년대 미국 수요, 나가노 생사 조합의 품질 표준화, 이탈리아 개별 상인 판매)도 무리 없음. 표준 SAT 중간 난이도에 부합.

advisory.note: 주어와 동사 사이에 긴 삽입절이 있어 수 일치와 정동사 여부를 둘 다 판단해야 하므로 medium 난이도에 맞다. 오답 A는 끌림 효과로 고르기 쉬운 함정이고, B와 D는 분사라서 문장이 불완전해진다.

problem.passage:
In the late eighteenth century, landowners in northern Scotland began financing curing yards, cooperages, and harbor piers along the coast. The investment, which many estate managers defended as a way to employ tenants displaced by agricultural changes, ______ the region's capacity to export salted herring to markets in the Baltic and the Caribbean.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In the late eighteenth century, landowners in northern Scotland began financing curing yards, cooperages, and harbor piers along the coast. The investment, which many estate managers defended as a way to employ tenants displaced by agricultural changes, ______ the region's capacity to export salted herring to markets in the Baltic and the Caribbean.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: having greatly expanded
were greatly expanding
greatly expanding
greatly expanded
problem.explanation: 주어는 단수 명사 'The investment'이고, 그 뒤의 'which ... changes' 관계절은 삽입된 수식어일 뿐이다. 따라서 빈칸에는 단수 주어와 일치하는 정동사가 필요하며, D의 'greatly expanded'가 이 조건을 충족한다. B는 정동사이긴 하지만 복수형 'were'가 관계절 속 'tenants'나 'changes'에 이끌린 오류로, 단수 주어와 맞지 않는다. A와 C는 분사 형태여서 주절에 정동사가 없는 불완전한 문장이 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of the main clause is the singular noun "The investment." The clause "which ... changes" is just an interrupting modifier. So the blank needs a finite verb that agrees with a singular subject, and D, "greatly expanded," does exactly that. B is a finite verb, but its plural "were" looks like it agrees with the nearby plural nouns "tenants" or "changes" instead of with the actual subject. A and C are participles, so choosing either one leaves the main clause without a finite verb, and the sentence is incomplete.

quality.seed: economics and business — Scottish herring fishing industry and landed estates investment in salting infrastructure export capacity

hardJudge.note: 주어 'The investment'(단수) + 긴 관계절 삽입 후 정동사 필요. D만 단수 정동사로 옳음. B는 인접 복수명사(tenants/changes) 유인 오답, A·C는 비정동사로 주절 동사 부재. 한·영 해설 모두 정답·글자 참조 일치, 한글 혼입 없음. 역사적 배경(스코틀랜드 청어 수출)도 사실과 부합. 삽입구 건너뛰기+수일치의 두 단계 판단으로 medium 적합.

advisory.note: 긴 삽입 관계절이 주어와 동사를 떼어 놓고, 단·복수 일치와 정동사 여부를 함께 따져야 해서 medium 수준에 맞음. 역사 서술(18세기 후반 스코틀랜드 북부의 청어 어업 투자)도 그럴듯함.

problem.passage:
In the early nineteenth century, a small group of London merchants who bought Bengal indigo at the East India Company's auctions quietly agreed not to bid against one another. The arrangement, which allowed the traders to hold auction prices well below what European dyers would have paid, ______ planters in Bengal with little choice but to sell at a loss, and growing resentment over these terms eventually fed the 1859 Indigo Revolt.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In the early nineteenth century, a small group of London merchants who bought Bengal indigo at the East India Company's auctions quietly agreed not to bid against one another. The arrangement, which allowed the traders to hold auction prices well below what European dyers would have paid, ______ planters in Bengal with little choice but to sell at a loss, and growing resentment over these terms eventually fed the 1859 Indigo Revolt.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: leaving
having left
left
to leave
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 "The arrangement"이고, 콤마 사이의 관계절("which allowed ... would have paid")은 삽입된 수식어일 뿐이다. 따라서 주절을 완성하려면 빈칸에 정동사가 와야 하며, 과거 시제 정동사 "left"를 쓴 C가 정답이다. A의 "leaving"과 B의 "having left"는 분사라서 주절에 정동사가 없는 불완전한 문장을 만든다. 관계절 안의 "allowed"를 주절 동사로 착각하면 분사가 자연스러워 보이지만, 그 동사는 관계절에 속한다. D의 "to leave"는 부정사여서 역시 정동사 역할을 하지 못한다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is "The arrangement," and the clause set off by commas ("which allowed ... would have paid") is just an interrupting modifier. To complete the main clause, the blank needs a finite verb, so C, the past-tense "left," is correct. A ("leaving") and B ("having left") are participles, so they would leave the sentence without a main verb. If you mistake "allowed" for the main verb, a participle might look fine, but "allowed" belongs to the relative clause. D ("to leave") is an infinitive, so it can't serve as the main verb either.

quality.seed: economics and business — Indian indigo dye cartel and price fixing by London traders during colonial monopoly period

hardJudge.note: 주어 "The arrangement" + 삽입 관계절("which allowed ... paid") 뒤에 주절 정동사가 필요하므로 과거형 "left"(C)가 유일하게 완전한 문장을 만든다. A·B는 관계절의 "allowed"를 주절 동사로 오인하면 그럴듯해 보이는 분사형, D는 부정사로 모두 정동사 결여. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 C를 일관되게 뒷받침하고 글자 참조가 선택지와 일치하며 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 1859년 인디고 반란 등 역사적 배경도 무리 없음. 삽입 수식어를 건너뛰어 주어-동사 구조를 파악해야 하는 전형적 medium 수준의 문항.

advisory.note: 주어-삽입 관계절-정동사 구조를 묻는 표준 중간 난이도 문항이다. 관계절 동사 allowed 때문에 분사가 그럴듯해 보이도록 설계된 함정이 있다. 역사적 배경(인디고 반란 1859)은 대체로 사실과 맞지만, 런던 상인 담합 서술은 검증이 어렵다. 다만 문법 문항이라 정답 판정에는 영향이 없다.

problem.passage:
In the late eighteenth century, Staffordshire potters such as Josiah Wedgwood faced a persistent problem: rival workshops copied their most popular designs almost as soon as they appeared in London showrooms. Wedgwood's partner, Thomas Bentley, urged a two-part strategy. The firm would register its patterns where the law allowed and pursue imitators in court, an expensive and often slow ______ it would also stamp its name on every piece, so that buyers could distinguish an authentic jasperware vase from a cheaper knockoff.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In the late eighteenth century, Staffordshire potters such as Josiah Wedgwood faced a persistent problem: rival workshops copied their most popular designs almost as soon as they appeared in London showrooms. Wedgwood's partner, Thomas Bentley, urged a two-part strategy. The firm would register its patterns where the law allowed and pursue imitators in court, an expensive and often slow ______ it would also stamp its name on every piece, so that buyers could distinguish an authentic jasperware vase from a cheaper knockoff.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: process;
process,
process
process, and,
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 "The firm would register ... an expensive and often slow process"는 동격구가 붙은 독립절이고, 뒤 "it would also stamp..."도 주어와 동사를 갖춘 독립절이다. 두 독립절은 세미콜론으로 연결해야 하므로 A가 정답이다. B는 쉼표만 써서 쉼표 접합(comma splice)이 된다. C는 문장부호 없이 두 절을 이어 붙여 무종지문(run-on)이 된다. D는 "and" 뒤에 불필요한 쉼표를 넣었고, 동격구 뒤에서 "and"가 절을 잇는 것인지 동격구에 이어지는 것인지 구조도 흐려지므로 관례에 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The part before the blank, "The firm would register ... an expensive and often slow process," is an independent clause that ends with an appositive phrase. The part after it, "it would also stamp...," is a second independent clause with its own subject and verb. Two independent clauses like these can be joined with a semicolon, so A is correct. B uses only a comma, which creates a comma splice. C uses no punctuation at all, which creates a run-on sentence. D adds an unneeded comma after "and," and it also blurs the structure, since a reader can't easily tell whether "and" joins two clauses or continues the appositive, so it doesn't follow standard conventions.

quality.seed: economics and business — British pottery manufacturers brand licensing and knockoff litigation defending designs in Staffordshire

hardJudge.note: 검산: 빈칸 앞은 동격구("an expensive and often slow process")로 끝나는 독립절, 뒤는 "it would also stamp..." 독립절. 세미콜론(A)이 유일하게 올바름. B 쉼표 접합, C 무종지문, D는 "and" 뒤 불필요 쉼표로 비표준. 난이도: 동격구를 절의 끝으로 인식한 뒤 두 독립절 연결 규칙을 적용해야 하는 2단계 판단이 있고, D(쉼표+and 구조와 유사)가 유력한 오답으로 기능. B도 앞의 동격 쉼표와 혼동 가능. 다만 B·C가 비교적 전형적인 오답이라 medium 하단에 가까움. 역사적 사실(Wedgwood·Bentley 파트너십, 재스퍼웨어, 제품 각인)은 "where the law allowed"로 적절히 헤지되어 문제 없음.

advisory.note: 독립절 끝에 동격구가 붙어 있어서 훑어 읽으면 쉼표(B)를 고르기 쉽다. 이 점이 medium 난이도의 함정으로 적절하게 작동한다. D(process, and,)는 and 뒤 쉼표가 명백히 틀려서 다소 쉽게 배제되지만 허용 범위다.

problem.passage:
Portugal supplies roughly half of the world's cork, and its manufacturing cluster near Santa Maria da Feira depends on a strict harvesting rhythm. A cork oak may be stripped only once every nine years, a legally enforced interval that allows the bark to regrow without injuring the tree______ of this slow cycle, processors negotiate with landowners years in advance to keep their supply chains stable.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Portugal supplies roughly half of the world's cork, and its manufacturing cluster near Santa Maria da Feira depends on a strict harvesting rhythm. A cork oak may be stripped only once every nine years, a legally enforced interval that allows the bark to regrow without injuring the tree______ of this slow cycle, processors negotiate with landowners years in advance to keep their supply chains stable.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: , because
; because
because
: and because
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 'A cork oak may be stripped... the tree'는 동격 수식어가 붙은 독립절이고, 빈칸 뒤 'because of this slow cycle, processors negotiate...'도 독립절이다. 'because of'는 종속접속사가 아니라 전치사구이므로 뒤 절을 종속시키지 못한다. 따라서 두 독립절은 세미콜론으로 이어야 하며, 정답은 B이다. A는 쉼표만으로 두 독립절을 이은 쉼표 오용(comma splice)이고, C는 문장부호가 아예 없어 무종지문(run-on)이 된다. D는 콜론 뒤에 등위접속사 'and'를 붙여 쓴 형태로, 이런 조합은 표준 용법이 아니다.
problem.explanationEn: The words before the blank, "A cork oak may be stripped... the tree," form an independent clause that includes a long appositive. The words after it, "because of this slow cycle, processors negotiate...," form a second independent clause. "Because of" is a prepositional phrase, not a subordinating conjunction, so it doesn't make the second clause dependent. Two independent clauses can be joined with a semicolon, so B is correct. A joins them with only a comma, which is a comma splice; C uses no punctuation at all, which makes a run-on sentence; and D pairs a colon with "and," a combination that isn't standard.

quality.seed: economics and business — Portuguese cork manufacturing cluster and bark harvesting sustainability practices maintaining supply chains

hardJudge.note: 검산: 빈칸 앞은 동격구를 포함한 독립절, 빈칸 뒤 'because of this slow cycle, processors negotiate...'는 'because of'가 전치사구이므로 독립절. 세미콜론(B)만 적법. A는 comma splice, C는 run-on, D는 콜론+and 비표준. 해설 한/영 모두 B를 일관되게 지지하며 글자 참조 일치, 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 사실 관계(포르투갈 세계 코르크 약 절반, Santa Maria da Feira 산업 집적지, 법정 9년 수확 간격) 정확. 난이도: 'because'가 종속접속사처럼 보여 A/C로 유도되는 함정 + 'because of'가 전치사구임을 확인하는 두 단계 판단이 필요해 medium에 적합. D는 가장 약한 오답이지만 기준상 허용 범위.

advisory.note: B는 정답이다. 'because of'가 전치사구라는 점, 그리고 빈칸 앞 절에 동격어가 들어 있다는 점을 함께 파악해야 하므로 2단계 판단이 필요하다. A와 C는 훑어 읽으면 고를 만한 그럴듯한 오답이다. D는 비표준 조합이라 비교적 쉽게 배제된다.

problem.passage:
In the late Middle Ages, brewing guilds in Flemish cities such as Ghent and Bruges did more than set prices: they codified which grains, herbs, and fermentation methods a beer had to use to be sold under a town's name. Economic historian Marc Verhoeven argues that these rules, though presented as guarantees of quality, also served a protective purpose. By requiring a specific local herb mixture known as gruit, which only guild-licensed merchants could ______ effectively barred hopped beers imported from Hamburg and Bremen from competing in Flemish markets.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In the late Middle Ages, brewing guilds in Flemish cities such as Ghent and Bruges did more than set prices: they codified which grains, herbs, and fermentation methods a beer had to use to be sold under a town's name. Economic historian Marc Verhoeven argues that these rules, though presented as guarantees of quality, also served a protective purpose. By requiring a specific local herb mixture known as gruit, which only guild-licensed merchants could ______ effectively barred hopped beers imported from Hamburg and Bremen from competing in Flemish markets.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: supply; the guilds
supply, and the guilds
supply. The guilds
supply, the guilds
problem.explanation: 이 문장은 "By requiring ... gruit"라는 전치사구(내부에 which로 시작하는 관계절 포함)로 시작하고, 주절의 주어 "the guilds"와 동사 "barred"가 뒤따른다. 도입 수식어구와 주절 사이는 쉼표 하나로 구분하는 것이 맞으므로 D가 정답이다. A의 세미콜론과 C의 마침표는 앞부분을 독립절처럼 끊어 버리지만, 앞부분은 주절이 없는 수식어구일 뿐이라 둘 다 문장 조각(fragment)이 된다. B는 쉼표+and로 두 독립절을 잇는 형태처럼 보이지만, 앞부분이 독립절이 아니어서 등위접속사가 이을 대상이 없다.
problem.explanationEn: This sentence opens with a long prepositional phrase, "By requiring ... gruit," which has a "which" relative clause inside it. The main clause comes after it, with the subject "the guilds" and the verb "barred." An introductory modifier is separated from the main clause by a single comma, so D is correct. A's semicolon and C's period treat the opening as if it were an independent clause, but it is only a modifier with no main clause of its own, so both leave a fragment. B looks like a comma plus "and" joining two independent clauses, but the first part isn't independent, so "and" has nothing to join it to.

quality.seed: economics and business — Belgian brewing guilds and beer style protection preventing foreign competition through recipe standardization

hardJudge.note: 검산: "By requiring ... gruit, which only guild-licensed merchants could supply, the guilds effectively barred ..." — 도입 전치사구(내부 관계절 포함) 뒤에 주절이 오므로 쉼표 하나(D)가 유일하게 올바름. A(세미콜론)·C(마침표)는 앞부분을 독립절로 취급해 조각을 만들고, B는 and가 이을 독립절이 없음. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 D를 일관되게 뒷받침하며 글자 참조 일치, 영어 해설에 한글 없음. 난이도: 긴 도입 수식어와 내부 관계절 때문에 앞부분을 독립절로 오인하기 쉬워 두 단계 판단(구조 파악 + 경계 규칙 적용)이 필요한 표준 medium 수준. Marc Verhoeven은 가상 인물로 보이나 문항 성립에 문제 없음.

advisory.note: 긴 도입구 안에 관계절이 들어 있어서 그 끝을 정확히 찾아야 한다. 마침표와 세미콜론(C, A)이 같은 이유로 배제되는 구조다. 정답은 명확하며 medium 난이도에 적합하다.

problem.passage:
Because Norwegian salmon are raised in open-net cages anchored in coastal fjords, parasitic sea lice can pass freely from farmed fish to wild salmon migrating past the pens, imposing a cost on wild fisheries that the farms themselves do not pay. To address this externality, Norway in 2017 adopted its "traffic light" system, a regulation that ties each coastal zone's permitted growth in salmon output to the sea lice levels measured on nearby wild fish ______ zones rated red must cut production, while zones rated green may expand.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Because Norwegian salmon are raised in open-net cages anchored in coastal fjords, parasitic sea lice can pass freely from farmed fish to wild salmon migrating past the pens, imposing a cost on wild fisheries that the farms themselves do not pay. To address this externality, Norway in 2017 adopted its "traffic light" system, a regulation that ties each coastal zone's permitted growth in salmon output to the sea lice levels measured on nearby wild fish ______ zones rated red must cut production, while zones rated green may expand.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: ; under this rule,
, under this rule;
, under this rule,
under this rule,
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 "Norway ... adopted its 'traffic light' system, ... wild fish"는 긴 동격 수식어가 붙어 있지만 독립절이고, 빈칸 뒤 "zones rated red must cut production..."도 독립절이다. 따라서 두 절 사이에는 세미콜론이 필요하고, 도입구 "under this rule" 뒤에는 쉼표를 쓰는 A가 정답이다. B는 세미콜론 자리가 잘못되어 있다. "under this rule"이 앞 절에 붙어 버리고 세미콜론 뒤에 오는 말과 분리된다. C는 두 독립절을 쉼표만으로 이은 쉼표 오류(comma splice)이다. D는 두 독립절 사이에 아무 문장부호도 없는 무종지문(run-on)이다.
problem.explanationEn: The text before the blank ("Norway ... adopted its 'traffic light' system, ... wild fish") is an independent clause, even though a long appositive is attached to it. The text after the blank ("zones rated red must cut production...") is also an independent clause. So you need a semicolon between the two clauses and a comma after the introductory phrase "under this rule," which makes A correct. B puts the semicolon in the wrong place: it attaches "under this rule" to the first clause and cuts it off from the clause it introduces. C joins two independent clauses with only a comma, which is a comma splice. D puts no punctuation between the clauses, which creates a run-on sentence.

quality.seed: economics and business — Norwegian salmon farming and open-net cage regulation creating negative externalities for wild fisheries

hardJudge.note: 검산: 빈칸 앞은 긴 동격구("a regulation that ... wild fish")가 붙은 독립절, 뒤는 독립절 → 세미콜론 + 도입구 뒤 쉼표인 A가 유일한 정답. B는 세미콜론 자체는 독립절 사이에 오지만 "under this rule"이 앞 절에 붙어 지시 대상이 자기 자신(the system)이 되어 논리적으로 어색하며, SAT 관례상 전환구는 뒤 절에 속해야 하므로 오답(그럴듯한 오답으로 기능). C 쉼표 오류, D 무종지문. 해설(한/영) 모두 A를 일관되게 뒷받침하고 글자 참조 일치. 노르웨이 2017년 신호등 제도 도입은 사실과 부합. 긴 동격구로 절 경계 식별이 두 단계 판단을 요구하므로 medium 적합.

advisory.note: 긴 동격구 때문에 앞 절이 독립절인지 판단해야 하고, B와 비교해 구 위치를 따져야 하므로 medium에 적합하다. B는 문법적으로 완전히 불가능하지는 않지만, 'under this rule'이 앞 절 끝에 붙으면 뜻이 어색하고 중복되므로 SAT 기준에서는 명확한 오답이다.

problem.passage:
In the seventeenth century, the Dutch East India Company (VOC) sought total control of the trade in cloves and nutmeg, spices that grew almost nowhere but the Maluku Islands. To keep prices high, company officials, directing operations from their headquarters at Batavia on Java, ordered clove trees on every island outside approved plantations cut down ______ armed fleets known as hongi expeditions sailed among the outer islands each year to uproot any seedlings planted without company permission.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In the seventeenth century, the Dutch East India Company (VOC) sought total control of the trade in cloves and nutmeg, spices that grew almost nowhere but the Maluku Islands. To keep prices high, company officials, directing operations from their headquarters at Batavia on Java, ordered clove trees on every island outside approved plantations cut down ______ armed fleets known as hongi expeditions sailed among the outer islands each year to uproot any seedlings planted without company permission.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: and,
, meanwhile,
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞 'company officials ... ordered ... cut down'은 독립절이고, 빈칸 뒤 'armed fleets ... sailed ...'도 주어와 동사를 갖춘 독립절이므로 두 절을 바르게 잇는 세미콜론을 쓴 B가 정답이다. 쉼표만 쓴 A는 두 독립절을 쉼표로 이어 붙인 comma splice이다. C는 등위접속사 and를 썼지만 쉼표가 and 뒤에 와서 'and'와 주어 'armed fleets' 사이를 부적절하게 끊는다. D의 meanwhile은 접속부사이지 접속사가 아니라서, 앞에 쉼표만 두면 여전히 comma splice가 된다.
problem.explanationEn: The words before the blank, "company officials ... ordered clove trees ... cut down," make an independent clause, and the words after it, "armed fleets ... sailed ...," make a second independent clause with its own subject and verb. A semicolon correctly joins two independent clauses, so B is correct. A puts only a comma between the two clauses, which is a comma splice. C uses the conjunction "and," but the comma comes after "and," which wrongly separates the conjunction from the subject "armed fleets." D uses "meanwhile," which is a conjunctive adverb, not a conjunction, so putting only a comma in front of it still makes a comma splice.

quality.seed: economics and business — Indonesian spice monopoly and Dutch trading post enforcement preventing cultivation outside Java control

hardJudge.note: 빈칸 앞 'company officials ... ordered clove trees ... cut down'과 뒤 'armed fleets ... sailed ...' 모두 독립절이므로 세미콜론(B)이 유일하게 옳다. A는 comma splice, C는 'and' 뒤 쉼표가 접속사와 주어를 부당하게 분리, D는 접속부사 meanwhile 앞에 쉼표만 있어 comma splice. 삽입구('directing operations ... Java')와 긴 목적어 구조 때문에 절 경계 파악에 두 단계 판단이 필요하며, C·D가 부분적으로 그럴듯한 오답이라 medium에 적합. VOC·Maluku·Batavia·hongi 원정 관련 사실도 정확. 한·영 해설 모두 정답 B와 일치하고 자연스러움.

advisory.note: 첫 절 중간에 삽입구(directing operations ... on Java)가 있고 'ordered clove trees ... cut down'처럼 목적보어 구조가 쓰여 절 경계를 찾기가 조금 어렵다. 그래서 medium 난이도에 맞다. 오답 C와 D는 그럴듯한 함정이다. VOC와 hongi 원정에 관한 역사적 사실도 정확하다.

problem.passage:
Wool grease, the waxy secretion that refiners purify into lanolin for cosmetics and ointments, once fetched wildly unpredictable prices at Australian auctions. To manage that risk, several grazier cooperatives in New South Wales began buying futures contracts in the 1990s______ a sale price months ahead, members could plan shearing budgets without fearing a sudden collapse in demand.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Wool grease, the waxy secretion that refiners purify into lanolin for cosmetics and ointments, once fetched wildly unpredictable prices at Australian auctions. To manage that risk, several grazier cooperatives in New South Wales began buying futures contracts in the 1990s______ a sale price months ahead, members could plan shearing budgets without fearing a sudden collapse in demand.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: , by locking in
by locking in
: by locking in
; whereas by locking in
problem.explanation: 빈칸 앞은 독립절("several grazier cooperatives ... began buying futures contracts in the 1990s")이고, 빈칸 뒤도 "by locking in a sale price months ahead"라는 수식구 다음에 주어 members와 동사 could plan이 오는 독립절이다. 뒤의 절은 선물 계약을 산 이유와 효과를 설명하므로, 두 독립절을 잇고 설명을 이끄는 콜론을 쓴 C가 정답이다. A는 쉼표만으로 두 독립절을 이어 쉼표 오용(comma splice)이 된다. B는 문장부호가 아예 없어 무종지문(run-on)이 된다. D는 세미콜론 뒤에 종속접속사 whereas를 넣어 세미콜론 뒤가 독립절이 아니게 되고, 대조의 의미도 문맥과 맞지 않는다.
problem.explanationEn: The text before the blank is an independent clause ("several grazier cooperatives ... began buying futures contracts in the 1990s"). What comes after the blank is also an independent clause: after the modifying phrase "by locking in a sale price months ahead," you get the subject "members" and the verb "could plan." The second clause explains why the cooperatives bought the contracts and what that achieved, so C is correct, because a colon can join two independent clauses when the second one explains the first. A joins the two independent clauses with only a comma, which makes a comma splice. B has no punctuation at all, so it's a run-on sentence. D puts the subordinating conjunction "whereas" after the semicolon, so what follows the semicolon is no longer an independent clause, and a contrast doesn't fit the meaning here anyway.

quality.seed: economics and business — Australian wool grease price volatility and futures market hedging adoption by grazier cooperatives

hardJudge.note: 빈칸 앞뒤 모두 독립절이며 뒤 절이 앞 절의 설명이므로 콜론(C)이 정답. A는 comma splice, B는 구두점 없음(또는 쉼표 오용), D는 세미콜론 뒤 종속접속사로 부적합하고 대조 의미도 어긋남. 두 절의 경계 파악 + 콜론의 설명 기능 확인이라는 두 단계 판단이 필요하고, B가 "by locking in"을 앞 절에 붙여 읽도록 유도하는 그럴듯한 오답이어서 medium에 적합. 소재(양모 기름→라놀린, 호주 양모 선물) 사실 오류 없음.

advisory.note: A, B는 'by locking in'을 앞 절에 붙여 읽으면 그럴듯해 보이는 함정이므로 중간 난이도에 맞다. D는 비교적 쉽게 배제된다.

problem.passage:
In the late sixteenth century, Viceroy Francisco de Toledo reorganized the mita, a rotational labor draft that Spanish officials adapted from an earlier Andean practice, to supply workers for the silver mines of Potosí. Indigenous communities that had already been bound to Spanish encomenderos through tribute obligations ______ the shafts of Cerro Rico, a mountain whose ore helped finance the Spanish Crown for generations.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: In the late sixteenth century, Viceroy Francisco de Toledo reorganized the mita, a rotational labor draft that Spanish officials adapted from an earlier Andean practice, to supply workers for the silver mines of Potosí. Indigenous communities that had already been bound to Spanish encomenderos through tribute obligations ______ the shafts of Cerro Rico, a mountain whose ore helped finance the Spanish Crown for generations.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: now had to send one-seventh of their adult men each year into
now had to send one-seventh of their adult men each year, into
now, had to send one-seventh of their adult men each year; into
now had to send one-seventh of their adult men each year: into
problem.explanation: 이 문장의 주어는 "Indigenous communities"이고, "that had already been bound ... obligations"는 그 주어를 한정하는 필수 관계절이며, 동사는 "had to send"이다. 전치사구 "into the shafts"는 동사 send의 방향을 나타내므로 동사와 끊으면 안 된다. 따라서 문장부호가 없는 A가 정답이다. B는 send와 into 사이에 쓸데없는 쉼표를 넣어 동사와 전치사구를 끊는다. C는 주어와 동사 사이에 쉼표를 넣고, 독립절이 뒤따르지 않는데도 세미콜론을 쓴다. D의 콜론은 앞에 완전한 절이 있어 보여도 동사와 꼭 필요한 전치사구를 갈라놓으므로 틀렸다.
problem.explanationEn: The subject of this sentence is "Indigenous communities." The clause "that had already been bound ... obligations" is an essential relative clause that restricts that subject, and the verb is "had to send." The phrase "into the shafts" tells where the men are sent, so it has to stay attached to "send." That's why A, with no punctuation, is correct. B adds an unnecessary comma between "send" and "into," which cuts the verb off from its phrase. C puts a comma between the subject and verb, and it uses a semicolon even though no independent clause comes after it. D might look fine because a complete clause comes before the colon, but the colon still separates the verb from a phrase it needs, so D is wrong.

quality.seed: economics and business — Peruvian silver mining labor exploitation and encomienda system extracting colonial wealth suppression

hardJudge.note: 정답 A 검산 완료: 주어 "Indigenous communities (that ... obligations)" + 동사 "had to send" + 목적어 + 필수 전치사구 "into the shafts" 사이에 어떤 문장부호도 필요 없음. B(쉼표)와 D(콜론, 앞이 완전절이라 그럴듯함)는 부분적 근거가 있어 비교가 필요하고, C는 주어-동사 분리 쉼표와 독립절 없는 세미콜론으로 명확히 배제됨. 역사적 사실(톨레도의 미타 재편, 성인 남성 1/7 징발, 세로 리코)도 정확. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 선택지 글자 참조가 일치하고 결론이 동일함.

advisory.note: 긴 주어와 관계절 때문에 주어-동사-전치사구 구조를 찾아야 풀린다. D의 콜론과 B의 쉼표는 앞이 완전한 절처럼 보여 그럴듯한 오답이다. 역사 사실(톨레도의 미타 개편, 1/7 징발)도 정확하다.

problem.passage:
In the thirteenth century, a merchant traveling from Genoa to the fairs of Champagne faced a costly problem: carrying chests of silver coins across the Alps invited robbery, and coins minted in one city often had uncertain value in another. Genoese bankers addressed this by refining the bill of exchange, a written order in which a banker in one city promised that a partner in a distant city would pay the bearer a fixed sum in local currency. Historians have often celebrated the bill mainly as a safer way to move money. Yet the bankers' records suggest its larger effect lay elsewhere. Because payment came weeks after the bill was issued and in a different currency, the exchange rate written on the bill could quietly build in a charge for the delay. That let bankers earn what was in effect interest at a time when Church law condemned openly charging it, and it made lending over long distances both profitable and permissible.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
problem.stimulus: In the thirteenth century, a merchant traveling from Genoa to the fairs of Champagne faced a costly problem: carrying chests of silver coins across the Alps invited robbery, and coins minted in one city often had uncertain value in another. Genoese bankers addressed this by refining the bill of exchange, a written order in which a banker in one city promised that a partner in a distant city would pay the bearer a fixed sum in local currency. Historians have often celebrated the bill mainly as a safer way to move money. Yet the bankers' records suggest its larger effect lay elsewhere. Because payment came weeks after the bill was issued and in a different currency, the exchange rate written on the bill could quietly build in a charge for the delay. That let bankers earn what was in effect interest at a time when Church law condemned openly charging it, and it made lending over long distances both profitable and permissible.
problem.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
options: Genoese bankers created the bill of exchange chiefly to protect merchants from robbers on Alpine routes to the Champagne fairs.
Genoese bankers relied on the bill of exchange mainly to settle the uncertain value of coins minted in different cities.
Genoese bankers used the bill of exchange in a way that hid a fee for the time before payment, which made long-distance lending workable under religious rules.
Genoese bankers depended on the bill of exchange because Church law required merchants to pay debts only in local currency.
problem.explanation: 지문은 어음이 흔히 안전한 송금 수단으로 평가되지만, 'Yet' 이후에 더 큰 효과가 따로 있었다고 주장한다. 그 효과란 환율 안에 지급 지연에 대한 대가를 넣어 교회법을 어기지 않고 사실상 이자를 받을 수 있었다는 점이다. 따라서 정답은 C이다. A와 B는 지문 앞부분에 나오는 문제를 말하지만, 지문은 그것이 주된 의의가 아니라고 반박한다. D는 교회법이 현지 통화 지급을 요구했다고 하는데, 이는 지문에 없는 내용이다.
problem.explanationEn: The text says the bill of exchange is usually praised as a safer way to move money, but after "Yet" it argues that the bill's larger effect lay elsewhere. That effect was building a charge for delayed payment into the exchange rate, which let bankers earn interest without breaking Church law. So C is correct. A and B describe problems mentioned at the start, but the text explicitly says those were not the main significance. D claims Church law required payment in local currency, and the text never says that.

quality.seed: economics and business — Genoese bankers and bills of exchange innovation revolutionizing medieval long-distance commercial credit

hardJudge.note: 정답 C는 'Yet' 이후의 핵심 주장(환율에 지연 비용을 숨겨 교회법 하에서 사실상 이자를 받아 장거리 대출을 가능하게 함)을 정확히 요약한다. A·B는 지문 도입부의 문제(강도, 통화 가치 불확실)를 주된 의의로 오인한 매력적 오답이며, D는 교회법 내용을 왜곡한 오답으로 말이 된다. 한국어·영어 해설 모두 결론과 선택지 참조가 일치하고 자연스럽다. 역사적 서술(13세기 제노바 어음, 이자 금지 우회)도 통설과 부합한다. 'Yet' 전환 인식과 두 정보(지연+환율 → 숨은 이자) 연결이 필요하여 medium에 적합.

advisory.note: 'Yet' 앞뒤의 대비를 파악해야 풀 수 있고, A·B는 지문 앞부분의 세부 내용을 활용한 그럴듯한 오답이다. D는 지문에 없는 인과를 덧붙인 오답이다. 난이도 medium에 맞다.

problem.passage:
In the fifteenth century, the Medici family of Florence built a banking enterprise with branches in cities such as Rome, Venice, Geneva, Bruges, and London. Historians once credited the bank's reach mainly to the family's close ties with the papacy, which deposited large sums with the Medici and used them to move church revenues across Europe. Yet economic historian Raymond de Roover argued that the organization of the network mattered at least as much. Each branch was set up as a separate partnership in which a local manager invested his own capital and shared in the profits, so a loss in one city could not automatically drag down the others. Branches also settled accounts with one another through bills of exchange, letting a merchant pay in Bruges and collect funds in Florence without shipping coins. In de Roover's view, this structure turned a family business into something closer to an international system for transferring money and managing risk.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
problem.stimulus: In the fifteenth century, the Medici family of Florence built a banking enterprise with branches in cities such as Rome, Venice, Geneva, Bruges, and London. Historians once credited the bank's reach mainly to the family's close ties with the papacy, which deposited large sums with the Medici and used them to move church revenues across Europe. Yet economic historian Raymond de Roover argued that the organization of the network mattered at least as much. Each branch was set up as a separate partnership in which a local manager invested his own capital and shared in the profits, so a loss in one city could not automatically drag down the others. Branches also settled accounts with one another through bills of exchange, letting a merchant pay in Bruges and collect funds in Florence without shipping coins. In de Roover's view, this structure turned a family business into something closer to an international system for transferring money and managing risk.
problem.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
options: According to one scholar, the way the Medici arranged their branches, rather than papal connections alone, explains how the bank came to function as a cross-border financial system.
According to one scholar, the Medici relationship with the papacy was the main reason the bank was able to open branches in cities across Europe.
According to one scholar, bills of exchange were first invented by Medici managers so that merchants could avoid the dangers of transporting coins.
According to one scholar, separate partnerships made Medici branch managers more loyal to their own cities than to the family in Florence.
problem.explanation: 지문은 예전 역사가들의 설명(교황청과의 관계)을 소개한 뒤, de Roover가 분리된 파트너십과 환어음 결제 같은 지점망 조직이 적어도 그만큼 중요했고, 이것이 메디치 은행을 국제 송금·위험 관리 체계로 만들었다고 주장했다는 내용이 중심이다. 그래서 A가 정답이다. B는 지문이 de Roover와 대비시키는 예전 견해를 그의 주장인 것처럼 제시한다. C는 지문에 나오는 환어음을 언급하지만, 메디치가 이를 발명했다는 말은 지문에 없다. D는 분리된 파트너십이라는 세부 정보를 바탕으로, 지문에 근거가 없는 충성심 문제를 추론한다.
problem.explanationEn: The text first gives an older explanation for the bank's success (its ties to the papacy). It then presents de Roover's argument that the way the network was organized, through separate partnerships and settlements by bill of exchange, mattered at least as much and turned the bank into an international system. That is why A is correct. B gives the older view that the text sets against de Roover as if it were his own claim. C mentions bills of exchange, which do appear in the text, but the text never says the Medici invented them. D starts from the detail about separate partnerships but draws a conclusion about loyalty that the text doesn't support.

quality.seed: economics and business — Medici banking family and branch network expansion establishing international financial service infrastructure

hardJudge.note: 지문 구조(기존 견해 → de Roover의 반론 → 조직 세부 → 결론 '국제 송금·위험 관리 체계')가 A와 정확히 일치하며, "rather than papal connections alone"은 "at least as much"를 적절히 반영한다. B는 지문에 실제로 등장하는 기존 견해를 de Roover 주장으로 바꿔치기한 오답, C는 지문의 환어음 세부를 '발명'으로 과장한 오답, D는 분리 파트너십 세부에서 근거 없는 충성심 추론을 끌어낸 오답으로, 세 오답 모두 지문 요소에 부분적으로 근거해 비교·정독이 필요하다. 역사적 사실(지점 도시, de Roover의 분권적 파트너십 해석)에 오류 없음. 한·영 해설 결론과 선택지 참조 일치, 영어 해설 자연스럽고 한글 없음.

advisory.note: A의 'rather than papal connections alone'은 지문의 'at least as much'와 맞는다. B는 이전 견해를 de Roover의 주장으로 돌리는 오답이고, C·D는 지문 세부에서 근거 없이 확장한 오답이다. 지점의 분리 파트너십 구조와 환어음 등 역사적 내용도 de Roover의 연구와 일치한다.

problem.passage:
In the fourteenth century, English kings faced a persistent problem: wool was the kingdom's most valuable export, but taxing thousands of scattered growers and traders was nearly impossible for a royal administration with few officials. The solution that emerged was the Staple, a system that required most raw wool bound for foreign markets to pass through a single designated town—eventually Calais—where a licensed company of merchants held the exclusive right to sell it. Although historians often describe the Staple as a privilege that enriched a narrow merchant elite, its more important function was administrative. By funneling the trade through one location controlled by a small group, the crown could collect export duties efficiently, and the Staplers themselves, in exchange for keeping their monopoly, frequently advanced loans to the king secured against future customs revenue. The merchants' profits, in other words, were the price the crown paid for a reliable mechanism of revenue collection.

Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
problem.stimulus: In the fourteenth century, English kings faced a persistent problem: wool was the kingdom's most valuable export, but taxing thousands of scattered growers and traders was nearly impossible for a royal administration with few officials. The solution that emerged was the Staple, a system that required most raw wool bound for foreign markets to pass through a single designated town—eventually Calais—where a licensed company of merchants held the exclusive right to sell it. Although historians often describe the Staple as a privilege that enriched a narrow merchant elite, its more important function was administrative. By funneling the trade through one location controlled by a small group, the crown could collect export duties efficiently, and the Staplers themselves, in exchange for keeping their monopoly, frequently advanced loans to the king secured against future customs revenue. The merchants' profits, in other words, were the price the crown paid for a reliable mechanism of revenue collection.
problem.question: Which choice best states the main idea of the text?
options: The Staple mainly benefited a small group of English merchants, who used their control of the wool trade at Calais to earn large profits.
The Staple was created because English wool had become so valuable that foreign buyers were willing to travel to a single town to purchase it.
The Staple served primarily as a means for the crown to gather money from the wool trade, with merchant privileges functioning as compensation for that service.
The Staple allowed English kings to borrow money from merchants, which reduced the crown's need to tax wool exports at all.
problem.explanation: 지문은 Staple이 흔히 상인 엘리트의 특권으로 묘사되지만 실제 더 중요한 기능은 왕실의 세입 징수 수단이었고, 상인의 이익은 그 대가였다고 주장하므로 C가 정답이다. A는 지문이 반박하려는 통념(상인 엘리트의 부)을 중심 내용으로 삼아 틀렸다. B는 양모의 가치라는 세부를 다루지만, 지문은 제도가 생긴 이유를 외국 구매자가 아니라 과세의 어려움으로 설명한다. D는 대출을 언급하지만, 대출은 미래 관세 수입을 담보로 한 것이어서 과세를 대체하지 않았으므로 틀렸다.
problem.explanationEn: The text grants that the Staple is often described as a privilege for a merchant elite, but it argues that the system's more important job was helping the crown collect revenue, and that merchant profits were the price paid for this. That makes C correct. A treats the common view the text pushes back on as if it were the main point. B picks up the detail about wool's value, but the text says the system came about because taxing the trade was hard, not because foreign buyers were willing to travel. D brings up the loans, but those loans were secured against future customs revenue, so they relied on taxing wool rather than replacing it.

quality.seed: economics and business — English wool export monopoly Staple and royal revenue collection through merchant licensing fees

hardJudge.note: 지문의 양보("historians often describe...")와 실제 주장("its more important function was administrative... profits were the price the crown paid")을 구분해야 C를 고를 수 있어 두 단계 판단이 요구됨. A는 지문이 인정하는 통념을 주제로 오인한 매력적 오답, D는 대출 세부를 활용하되 '관세 수입 담보'와 모순, B는 가치라는 세부를 원인으로 왜곡. 역사적 사실(Calais 스테이플, Staplers의 왕실 대출)도 정확. 한·영 해설 결론·글자 참조 일치, 영어 자연스럽고 한글 없음.

advisory.note: 통념-반박 구조로 되어 있어 A가 강한 함정 역할을 한다. B와 D는 지문의 세부(양모의 가치, 대출)를 근거로 삼아 그럴듯하다. 역사적 사실도 대체로 정확하다(Calais Staple, 관세 수입을 담보로 한 대출). medium 난이도에 적합하다.

problem.passage:
